Perfect! All 70 tests pass. I've added the invoice numbering system:

**`src/numbering.js`** — New module with `nextInvoiceNumber(existingNumbers, issueDate)` that:
- Generates invoice numbers in format `INV-<year>-<counter>`
- Counter is 4-digit zero-padded (0001, 0002, ..., 9999, 10000, etc.)
- Resets to 0001 for each new year
- Finds the highest counter from existing numbers for that year and increments it
- Handles numbers in any order

**`issueInvoice(invoice, existingNumbers)` in src/invoices.js** — Issues a draft invoice by:
- Generating the next invoice number
- Setting status to 'issued'
- Preserving all other invoice properties
- Returning `fail(NOT_DRAFT)` if the invoice isn't in draft status
- Never mutating the input

**Tests added:**
- 10 tests for `nextInvoiceNumber` covering year-based resets, counter padding, ordering, edge cases
- 7 tests for `issueInvoice` covering normal issuance, property preservation, immutability, multi-year scenarios

All 70 tests pass. ✅
